project_sessions.description:
Build a professional mobile application for visualizing protein ligands in 3D. 
You'll fetch molecular data from the RCSB Protein Data Bank, parse Chemical Information 
Files (.cif format), and render complex molecular structures using native 3D frameworks 
(SceneKit on iOS or equivalent on Android). The app features secure biometric authentication, 
interactive 3D models with CPK coloring and ball-and-stick representation, gesture-based 
controls for rotation and zoom, and social sharing capabilities. This project combines 
bioinformatics, mobile security, network programming, and advanced 3D graphics rendering.

objectives: Anticipation et planification des options à réaliser
project_sessions.description: Passez à la vitesse supérieure ! Suite du Wolf3D, le Doom Nukem pousse beaucoup plus loin les possibilités du Raycasting tout en y apportant une dimension de Game design, vous allez donc devoir réaliser un vrai jeu et pour cela c’est un mélange de Doom et de Duke Nukem 3D qu’il vous faudra réaliser ! De nombreux éléments fonctionnels de base sont identiques. Ils n’ont cependant pas été implémentés de la même façon par les concepteurs des deux jeux. A vous de trouver celle qui vous conviendra et qui vous permettra d’ajouter les features demandées comme celles que vous souhaitez y voir.

project_sessions.description: NetPractice is a hands-on networking project featuring 10 progressive levels that teach essential computer networking fundamentals. Through interactive problem-solving, you'll master TCP/IP addressing, subnet masks, default gateways, routing, and OSI layers by troubleshooting and configuring non-functioning network diagrams. This browser-based training provides practical experience in network administration, preparing you for real-world system administration and networking challenges.

project_sessions.description: Create a multiplayer text adventure that brings learners together in a shared virtual world with dynamic item management. Working in pairs, build a robust TCP server implementing RFC 42TAP (The Answer Protocol) using systems programming languages (Rust, Go, C++, Java, or C#), develop both command-line and graphical clients, and implement real-time networking features like chat, presence events, group coordination, and a sophisticated item economy. Master network programming concepts and RFC-compliant protocol implementation while crafting an engaging game experience where items exist as unique instances that can be taken, dropped, and shared between players, preventing duplication and creating realistic resource scarcity. Learn to write production-quality network protocols following Internet standards conventions with proper ABNF syntax definitions, comprehensive error handling, and formal technical documentation. Your collaborative code becomes the foundation of storytelling, exploration, and strategic resource management in a persistent networked world.

project_sessions.description: Design and implement an efficient drone routing system that navigates multiple autonomous drones from a central base to a target location through a dynamic network. This Python project challenges learners to create a custom pathfinding algorithm that handles simultaneous drone movement while respecting zone occupancy rules, movement costs, and conflict resolution. The system must parse complex map files, implement object-oriented design principles, and optimize for minimal simulation turns. Learners will develop skills in graph algorithms, concurrent pathfinding, and performance optimization while working with real-world constraints such as restricted zones, bottlenecks, and deadlock prevention.

project_sessions.description: Welcome to the Cosmic Data Observatory! As a junior Data Engineer at this interstellar research facility, you'll master Pydantic - Python's powerful data validation library - through engaging space-themed exercises. Learn to create robust data models, implement custom validation rules, and handle complex nested structures while processing data from space stations, alien contact reports, and crew missions. This hands-on project focuses on practical Pydantic skills: BaseModel fundamentals, Field constraints, and model_post_init validation. Perfect for discovering data validation concepts in an accessible 8-hour learning experience with a fun, inclusive cosmic theme that makes complex concepts easy to understand.

project_sessions.description: International Apprenticeship - A part-time work experience in the same company for an equivalent of 6 months full time.
This project introduces you to the fundamentals of decentralized finance (DeFi). You will build an Automated Market Maker (AMM) where users can swap tokens and buy/sell NFTs!

All programs that you wrote until now were executed in text mode on your terminal. Now, let’s discover something more exciting: how to open a graphics window and draw inside? To start your journey in graphic programming, FdF offers to represent “iron wire” meshing in 3D.
Discover 2D programming and the psychedelic universe of fractals in this project, using minilibX.
This project is a small 2D game with minilibx. You'll learn about textures, sprites and tiles.

This project aims to deepen your understanding of the two concepts that you already know: Redirections and Pipes. It is an introductory project for the bigger UNIX projects that will appear later on in the cursus.
The purpose of this project is to code a small data exchange program using UNIX signals. It is an introductory project for the bigger UNIX projects that will appear later on in the cursus.

This project is inspired by the world-famous eponymous 90's game, which was the first FPS ever. It will enable you to explore ray-casting. Your goal will be to make a dynamic view inside a maze, in which you'll have to find your way.
This project is an introduction to the beautiful world of Raytracing.
The objective of this project is for you to create a simple shell.
